title: Production-pod canary: depth levers (FUSED+FLASH) on the live serving pod, controlled load
purpose: Per collaborator gate framing: dev-pod number anchors the queenbee bar; production-pod measurement is operational canary verification, not a gate precondition. Confirm knob support + levers translate into proportional live-latency reduction on the actual serving pod.
prompt: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. We are benchmarking the Breeze TTS two model on the Radeon 780 M graphics card, measuring the real time factor of the full generation pipeline from the text encoder through the backbone and depth decoder.

q3_ffn_57a846aa.note: canonical prod receipt env (GGML_VK_ALLOW_GRAPHICS_QUEUE=1 + BREEZE_DD_BLOCKS=9) reproduced 0.004-different RTF and byte-identical audio vs the un-canonical run — the 0.002 flag cost reconfirms on prod

provenance_highlights: CROSS-POD BIT-EXACT (1): prod-pod 8c359295 baseline wav md5 d7272a91... == the original 09-16 0.7917-run wav (dd9-rtf-07917-verification-receipt.json). Same weights + env + seed => identical output bits across THREE binaries/pods (09-16 build, dev ef6e93de, prod 607db056).

CROSS-POD BIT-EXACT (2): combined-lever wav 8b50147d... identical between dev pod (dd9-depth-lever-probe.json clean_combined_rerun_single_voice) and prod pod. The fused+flash audio is stable across binary generations — what the ear gate hears in dev clips is what prod will emit.
DETERMINISM: both repeats per cell byte-identical (md5 .repeat-2 == base in all 8 cells).
anchor_correction: The 0.846 prod anchor (breezetts-prod-rtf-receipt.json) was measured at recorded loadavg 3.35. Today at load 0.76 the q3 baseline measures 0.871. The anchor is a regime number; the honest controlled-load prod baseline is 0.871 and the load-bearing figure is the lever delta (-0.034 q3, -0.020 student). Queenbee gate letter must cite controlled-load numbers, not the 0.846.
knob_support_confirmed: BREEZE_DD_FUSED / BREEZE_DD_FLASH_ATTN active in prod binary 607db056 (fused graph banner '1 fused graph (15 steps)' observed; flash via depth ms/frame drop with 15-static-graphs banner)
verdict: Levers translate into proportional live-latency reduction on the actual serving pod at controlled load: student 0.811 -> 0.791, q3 artifact 0.871 -> 0.837. Canary PASS. Deployment (env change only, no binary rollout) is ready to be gated on the ear gate + queenbee letters (c)/(d).
